name: walled-bowl
why: A spherical bowl, radius 40 about (0, 0, 40), lofted through 40 fitted circles from z = 0.5 to its equator as a 2 mm wall with a closed floor. At the floor the surface lies 9 degrees off horizontal, which the sideways step once refused; stepped along the surface normal, the inside is the sphere of radius 38 about the same centre. Closed form: pi * [rho^2 z - (z - 40)^3 / 3] between the planes, outer 0.5..40 less inner 2.5..40, 19116.068 mm3; the mesh reads a chord short. loft_wall_mm must read 2.000 everywhere.
